# WKL Labs

> WKL Labs LLC is an independent software studio that designs and builds applications, websites, Google Apps Script automation, and reporting dashboards, and operates its own products, Nabbee and Spell Collector.

## Company

- [Services](https://wkllabs.com/services): Applications, websites, automation, and reporting dashboards, with project examples and client reviews
- [About](https://wkllabs.com/about): The studio, its founder William Lim, and relevant experience
- [Contact](https://wkllabs.com/contact): Project enquiries and email address

## Products

- [Nabbee](https://nabbee.app): Online booking, deposits, and customer management for service businesses in the US and the Philippines
- [Spell Collector](https://spellcollector.com): A Magic: The Gathering and Pokémon marketplace for comparing prices, buying from local shops, and managing collections
